name: Herod Agrippa II
title: The Last Herodian King
summary: Herod Agrippa II was the last king of the Herodian dynasty and ruled over parts of northern Israel. He is best known from the Bible for hearing the apostle Paul's defense speech together with his sister Berenice, and uttering the famous phrase that Paul had almost persuaded him to become a Christian.

keyEvents.title: Festus Presents Paul's Case
keyEvents.description: The new governor Festus presented Paul's case to King Agrippa and Berenice, who had come to greet him in Caesarea.

keyEvents.title: Paul Brought Before Agrippa
keyEvents.description: At Agrippa's request, Paul was brought before the king and the entire assembly to explain his case.

keyEvents.title: Paul's Defense Speech
keyEvents.description: Paul made a long defense before Agrippa, telling about his life, his conversion, and his calling to preach to the Gentiles.

keyEvents.title: Agrippa's famous reply
keyEvents.description: After Paul's speech, Agrippa spoke these well-known words: 'You almost persuade me to become a Christian.' Paul replied that he wished all who heard him might become like him.

keyEvents.title: Agrippa declares Paul innocent
keyEvents.description: After the conversation, Agrippa and Festus withdrew and concluded that Paul had done nothing deserving death or imprisonment, but because he had appealed to Caesar, he must be sent to Rome.
